task_prompt: Wipe the kitchen counter with the paper towel.
task_summary: The right hand presses a white paper towel against the counter around the sink and makes repeated wiping strokes.

A held towel above the counter does not establish a completed wiping action.
objects.evidence: White towel is held against the counter in repeated strokes at 0-16 s.

objects.name: white kitchen counter
properties: Fixed surface around a recessed sink.

Wiping should be evaluated from contact and coverage over this area.
objects.evidence: White surface around the sink is visible throughout 0-17.5 s.
